description: Use this when preparing a customer-requested unpaid Samuelz Chauffeur offer (offerRequested=true). Do not use for prices (use quote_ride instead). Supply email or E.164 phone. Bind submissionId/resumeToken to unchanged ride, contact, locale, offerKey and partner context. Intake and unpaid state may persist after disconnect. Recover with get_offer_status and the original pair. prepared returns private checkoutUrl for customer confirmation/payment before offer.expiresAt. Wait retryAfterSeconds if given; review conflict/ambiguous. This call does not charge or confirm, dispatch or send messages.

contact.description: Customer email or phone for this requested offer.

email.description: Customer email, required when no phone is given.

phone.description: E.164 phone, required when no email is given.

distributionPartnerCapability.description: Existing dp_live_ partner token. Omit for customers.

firstTouchTrackingToken.description: Existing first-touch token. Never invent one.

locale.description: Customer-requested language for text and links: en (default) or de. Preserve it on retries and related calls; it changes presentation, never price or eligibility.

offerKey.description: Optional published supplier offer key, for example service_airport. Pass only a key supplied by the provider’s published context; otherwise omit to use the configured default. Preserve it across related calls and retries. It selects a service location and terms, not a booking ID or access grant.

offerRequested.description: True only after the customer explicitly asks for an offer.

resumeToken.description: Caller-generated private secret of 64 hexadecimal characters. Generate once, retain it with submissionId for recovery, and never share the pair publicly or replace it on uncertain retries.

ride.description: Pickup, destination, local date, time and passengers.

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-24, in the selected location’s time zone; do not convert it to a UTC date.

destination.description: Destination with city or postcode, distinct from pickup.

flightNumber.description: Flight number for an airport pickup, if known.

hours.description: Whole service hours from 1 to 24, for example 3. Required only for serviceType=hourly; omit for transfers. Billable hours may differ after price calculation.

luggage.description: Luggage notes. Unusual items may need review.

passengers.description: Number of people travelling, from 1 to 60.

pickup.description: Pickup place with city or postcode, inside a served area.

returnDate.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD, only for a return trip.

returnTime.description: Return time HH:mm, only for a return trip.

serviceType.description: Set hourly for duration service; omit for transfers.

time.description: Local pickup time in 24-hour HH:mm format, for example 14:30, in the selected location’s time zone.

tripType.description: one_way, or return with a later pickup.

vehiclePreference.description: Optional vehicle wish, without a price guarantee.

submissionId.description: Create one UUID for one explicitly requested offer, for example 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000. Retain it with the original resumeToken and unchanged request on retries.

name: prepare_offer

status.description: Input does not match this operation.
This read could not be completed safely.
No price: outside the published areas.
This offer intent is still pending.
conflict, ambiguous, or not_found. Do not create another offer.
